computation_method: Host python3 exact integer arithmetic and Decimal(110) logarithms only via scripts/certificate_check.py; no floats touch a bound; no candidate package executed at production size. All protected constants re-read from target-profile.json. Factorization of r-1 recomputed cold (trial division to 2^20 + Pollard rho + deterministic Miller-Rabin); xi=7 re-certified as primitive root over the full factorization; zeta/delta orders re-certified.
mechanism: Cheon d=2^20 two-phase BSGS in the ORDER-q subgroup and ORDER-d subgroup of the scalar field, executed on encoded points with honest chain pricing: every baby/giant chain step is ONE multiplication of a variable point by a PUBLIC fixed 255-bit scalar (zeta, zeta^{-m}, delta, delta^{-1024}), charged SM=512 reference additions. Table keys are FULL (x,y) pairs; success=1 from exact integer interval coverage of k2 and the exhaustive m2^2=d phase-2 grid; candidates resolved only by the charged verification [s]P0=T.

defect_fix_map.v4_rejected_cheon-ph-smooth-cofactor-40p: multiplicative Pohlig-Hellman was applied to encoded points: [q/l^e]A_d = [(q/l^e) zeta^k2]P0 is a scalar MULTIPLE, but PH needs the EXPONENTIATED encoded scalar [(zeta^k2)^(q/l^e)]P0; no G1 operation performs that. Fixed here by never exponentiating an encoded scalar: PH/BSGS indices are compared as integers in the scalar domain via exact grid coverage. Refuted empirically in experiments/grid_bsgs_toy.py T3 (0/4000 agreements).
defect_fix_map.v3_rejected_cheon-d20-deterministic-40pc: the geometric chain [zeta^{v+1}]P0 was priced as one G1 addition. B + vG with G=[zeta]P0 gives [(1+v zeta)]P0: an arithmetic progression in the exponent, not the geometric one the BSGS identity needs. Fixed here: chain steps are full public-scalar double-and-add (512 reference additions), which is why this honest claim (127.529390) is 8.78 bits WORSE than the rejected v3 number (118.750473). Refuted empirically in experiments/grid_bsgs_toy.py T2 (hit fraction 0.0020, every hit a wrong digit).
defect_fix_map.accepted_frontier_cheon-d20-hardened-40p: grid in the full order-r group. This package runs the same deterministic-grid shape in the order-q subgroup unlocked by the supplied A_d: sqrt(q)=2^117.43 chains at 512 = 2^126.4 group-equivalents, beating 134 by 6.470610 bits.

memory_reported_not_charged.model: m=2^117.43 records, load factor 1/2, 56-byte packed (48B x||y limbs + tag); giant chain streaming; phase-2 table 1024 records; one cold attempt

success_probability.basis: integer intervals [u*m, u*m+m-1], u<M, tile [0, M*m-1] and M*m >= q (cert C10), so every k2 in [0,q) is covered exactly once as an INDEX; full (x,y) keys mean no +/- collapse (r odd prime, no self-inverse nonidentity point, cert C4); top wraparound zone candidates (cert C11) and all candidates are gated by the unique verified [s]P0=T; phase-2 m2^2=d exhaustive (cert C12); decomposition bijective (cert C8). No heuristic.
